description: FlowSavvy turns your tasks into a realistic schedule automatically. Use ChatGPT to create, update, complete, and organize tasks, manage calendar events, view your schedule, prioritize work, and plan your day using natural language. FlowSavvy automatically schedules tasks around your existing commitments, adapts when plans change, and helps you stay on top of your deadlines without the hassle of manually rearranging your calendar.
